description: The Lois Creek Trails offers a variety of trail experiences. Trails are a mixture of double track and single track that weave through mature forest, rock outcroppings, and often alongside Lois Creek. The trails are generally beginner to intermediate with a few technical single track trails that contain some roots and loose rocks. Not only are the trails popular for biking and hiking in the non-snow months, they are also a local favorite for cross country skiing & snowshoeing in winter. For trail descriptions and details, visit http://www.tourismkimberley.com/content/lois-creek-trails
directions: The Lois Creek Trails are adjacent to the townsite subdivision with trail heads at the north end of Trail Street; at 8th Avenue where it intersects with Elko Street; and past Centennial Hall at the old Legion Track. There is plenty of parking at Centennial Hall.
title: Lois Creek Trails
